insight: Founded by ex-Google Search engineer Arvind Jain (also a Rubrik co-founder); hit a $7.2B valuation in June 2025.
name: Glean
tagline: Work AI: enterprise search, assistant, and agents over your apps.
description: A workplace AI platform that unifies search, an assistant, and agents across 100+ connected enterprise apps (Slack, Teams, GitHub, ServiceNow and more). It enforces each user's existing access permissions over the indexed content. Sold enterprise-only — pricing is quote-based via sales, with no public self-serve tier.

modelSupport.notes: Routes across leading LLMs behind the enterprise assistant.

edge: Permission-aware knowledge graph over 100+ apps that no-code agents can act on, not just search.
